data.one_liner: Flutter phone input FormField with internationalization, validation, and country selector.
data.what_it_does: Provides a FormField widget for international phone number input with formatting, validation, and a built-in country selector supporting multiple navigation styles (pages, dialogs, sheets). It localizes strings and country names into over 30 languages.
use_when: You need a form input specifically for international phone numbers.
You want built-in validation for mobile and fixed-line phone formats.
You require a country code selector with built-in search and flag display.
avoid_when: You only need a standard text input without specialized phone formatting or country selection.
You require features not supported by the underlying phone parsing library.
strengths: Flexible presentation options for the country selector (page, dialog, bottom sheet).
Integrates seamlessly as a standard Flutter FormField supporting autofill and copy-paste.
weaknesses: Web platform requires preloading flag assets to prevent flashing.
Strict dependency on specific Flutter and Dart versions.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding PhoneFieldLocalization delegates to your MaterialApp for full localization support.
